## Findings Brief — loft-2026-1105-med (AWS Builder Loft, 525 Market St, SF)

**Situation:** Adult male, unresponsive with abnormal breathing, collapsed at registration desk. Bystander CPR in progress, 911 called from a mobile phone, ~15-person crowd blocking the corridor to the main stage, no AED location known. Treat as sudden cardiac arrest [S4].

### Recommended response options
- **Keep CPR going without interruption.** Continue high-quality chest compressions until EMS arrives; rotate compressors every ~2 minutes if more than one rescuer is available [S14]. Compressions at 100–120/min, depth at least 5 cm (2 in), on the lower half of the breastbone [S4] [S5].
- **Put the 911 dispatcher on speaker and follow their instructions.** Do not hang up until the dispatcher gives permission; if unsure, hands-only CPR is the correct default [S2] [S1].
- **Dispatch a named person to find the AED now.** Send someone to retrieve the nearest AED even if the location is unknown — ask venue staff, check lobby/reception walls, kitchen, and the corridor to the main stage; defibrillation within 3–5 minutes sharply improves survival [S13] [S3] [S4].
- **Assign a separate named person to clear the corridor.** Move the ~15-person crowd back and off the path to the main stage so the AED and EMS can reach the victim; keep the area around the patient clear [S16] [S19].
- **Assign a greeter for EMS.** Give the dispatcher the exact location (registration desk, entrance, 525 Market St / First Market Tower) and the entry door, and have one person meet the paramedics at that door and walk them straight in [S17] [S19].

## Optimization of Dispatcher-Assisted Recognition of Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
Bystanders to cardiac arrest in the out-of-hospital setting typically call 9-1-1 to report the event. # San Francisco
## Geography
### Neighborhoods
The earliest center of San Francisco is Portsmouth Square, in the northeast quadrant of the city anchored by Market Street and the waterfront. Here in the northeast quadrant, the Financial District is centered, with Union Square, the principal shopping and hotel district, and the Tenderloin nearby. ## Economy
San Francisco's Financial District is considered the Wall Street of the West. ## Arts and culture
Although the Financial District, Union Square, and Fisherman's Wharf are well known around the world, San Francisco is also characterized by its numerous culturally rich streetscapes featuring mixed-use neighborhoods anchored around central commercial corridors to which residents and visitors alike can walk. Because of these characteristics, San Francisco is ranked the "most walkable" city in the United States by Walk Score.

# San Francisco
## Geography
### Neighborhoods
The earliest center of San Francisco is Portsmouth Square, in the northeast quadrant of the city anchored by Market Street and the waterfront. Here in the northeast quadrant, the Financial District is centered, with Union Square, the principal shopping and hotel district, and the Tenderloin nearby. ## Economy
San Francisco's Financial District is considered the Wall Street of the West. ## Arts and culture
Although the Financial District, Union Square, and Fisherman's Wharf are well known around the world, San Francisco is also characterized by its numerous culturally rich streetscapes featuring mixed-use neighborhoods anchored around central commercial corridors to which residents and visitors alike can walk. Because of these characteristics, San Francisco is ranked the "most walkable" city in the United States by Walk Score.
